blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning, which produces the transcript, timestamps, and a visual description of the speaker for every utterance in a video. Considering that utterance timing and audiovisual diarization are tightly coupled, DiaCap unifies the tasks in a single model, trained in two complementary stages. First, we train DiaCap on 225K curated clips, using synthetic captions that densely label every utterance in detail. Second, we further refine the model via reinforcement learning on 2.9K human-corrected clips, using fine-grained feedback that directly evaluates utterance timing, speaker grouping, and speaker binding. On DiaDemBench, which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction, both DiaCap with off-the-shelf transcripts and its end-to-end variant DiaCap-E2E achieve strong results. Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon in audiovisual diarization while clearly outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs. 42.76 TIME). It also maintains strong diarization on multilingual and minute-long videos, and transfers to audiovisual question answering.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍DiaCap,这是一个用于全面对话字幕的视听LLM,它制作记录稿、时间戳和视频中每句话的发言者的视觉描述。 考虑到话语时间和视听分化紧密结合,DiaCap将任务统一在一个模式中,经过两个互补阶段的培训。 首先,我们用225K编译的剪辑来训练DiaCap, 使用合成的字幕, 其次,我们通过对2.9K人修补的剪辑进行强化学习,利用精细的反馈,直接评价发表时间、演讲者分组和演讲者捆绑,进一步完善模型。 在DiaDem Bench上,我们用语音级别的时间戳和字幕编辑来扩展它,DiaCap与现成的笔录及其端到端的变体DiaCap-E2E都取得了很强的成果. 具体来说,DiaCap在视听分化方面与双子座4Argon同等,同时在时间戳准确性方面明显地优于双子座(76.59对42.76 Time)。 它还对多语种和短片录像保持强烈的分化,并转而回答视听问题。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Comprehensive dialogue captioning requires more than accurate speech transcription: a model must also localize when each utterance occurs and identify who speaks it ( Fig. 1 ).
Unlike conventional speaker diarization [ 43 , 21 , 4 ] , which assigns anonymous labels even when it uses visual cues [ 12 , 83 , 49 ] , audiovisual diarization describes each speaker by detailed visual appearance.
However, general-purpose audiovisual LLMs [ 85 , 64 , 25 , 26 ] and existing dialogue captioners [ 8 , 72 ] have yet to reliably determine when and who together, particularly in multi-person scenes or with speakers moving in and out of view.
blocks.zh:
全面的对话字幕需要的不仅仅是准确的语音转录:在每次发表言论时,一个模型还必须本地化,并指明谁说(图1)。
与传统扬声器对接[43,21,4]不同的是,它即使使用视觉提示[12,83,49],也会指定匿名标签,而视听对接则通过详细的视觉外观来描述每个扬声器.
然而,通用视听LLMS[85、64、25、26]和现有的对话字幕[8、72]尚未可靠地确定何时和谁一起使用,特别是在多人场景中或在发言者进出视线时使用。

blocks.en:
We argue that this challenge stems from learning utterance timing and speaker attribution separately, even though they are tightly coupled.
For example, knowing who is speaking helps locate utterance boundaries, while accurate boundaries are needed to bind each utterance to the right speaker.
We present DiaCap , an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning ( Fig. 2 ) that unifies both tasks in a single model by learning from two complementary signals.
First, dense supervision provides complete captions that label every utterance with its transcript, timestamps, and speaker, and describe each speaker by visual appearance.
Second, as a more direct signal, fine-grained feedback evaluates how accurately each utterance is timed and whether each speaker is correctly identified.
blocks.zh:
我们争辩说,这一挑战源于学习发言时间和发言者的归属,尽管两者密切相关。
例如,了解谁说话有助于确定语音边界,同时需要准确的边界来将每句话与正确的语音连接起来。
我们介绍DiaCap,这是用于全面对话字幕的视听LLM(图2),通过学习两个互补信号,将这两项任务统一在一个模式中。
首先,密集的监管提供了完整的字幕,用其笔录、时间戳和扬声器来标注每句话,并以视觉外观来描述每个扬声器。
其次,作为更直接的信号,精细的反馈评价每句话的准确性,以及每个发言者是否被正确识别.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Comprehensive dialogue captioning. DiaCap describes who says what , and when , in a single caption. Whereas audio-only diarization assigns each speaker only an anonymous ID, DiaCap identifies each speaker with a detailed description.
blocks.zh: 图1:全面对话标题。 DiaCap用一个单行本来描述谁在说什么,什么时候呢。 虽然只有音频的对称化只指定了每个发言者一个匿名的ID,而DiaCap则对每个发言者进行详细的描述.

blocks.en:
To provide dense supervision at scale, we first train DiaCap with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on 225K clips, curated from 1.25M raw clips to ensure audiovisual correspondence and a balanced data distribution.
Since manual annotation is impractical at this scale, we label these clips with a synthetic annotation pipeline that combines the strengths of two models.
An audiovisual LLM [ 25 , 64 ] yields accurate transcripts and diarization but only coarse timestamps, whereas a speech aligner [ 41 ] localizes speech precisely but cannot see the speakers.
We retain the speaker-attributed utterances from the audiovisual LLM and refine their timestamps with the aligner.
Because the pipeline chains several models and is thus complex and costly to run, we use it only as an offline data engine.
blocks.zh:
为了提供规模的密集监督,我们首先对DiaCap进行225K片段的有监督的微调(SFT)培训,从1.25M片段的原始片段进行曲调,以确保视听通信以及平衡的数据分布。
由于手工注解在这个尺度上是不切实际的,所以我们将这些片段用合成注解管来标出两个模型的优点.
视听LLM[25,64]产生准确的文字记录和分化,但只有粗糙的时间戳,而语音校正[41]则精确地将发言本地化,但不能看到发言者。
我们保留了视听LLM中带有发言特征的言论,并用配音器改进了时间戳。
由于输油管连载了几种模型,因此复杂且运行成本高,所以我们仅将其作为离线数据引擎使用.

blocks.en:
The next-token objective of SFT imitates the reference caption token by token, without directly measuring the accuracy of the predicted timestamps and speaker assignments.
We therefore further optimize DiaCap via reinforcement learning (RL) [ 91 ] , using fine-grained feedback as the reward.
The RL data consists of about 2.9K human-corrected clips mined from visually challenging scenarios, such as multi-person scenes, small or blurry faces, and delayed speaker appearances.
Instead of a single score that conflates different error types, our reward decomposes into three terms.
A timestamp reward scores each predicted utterance boundary by its distance from the reference.
For diarization, a description-agnostic grouping reward checks whether each person’s utterances share a single predicted speaker, penalizing both splitting one person and merging several people.
A binding reward then asks a multimodal judge whether each predicted description refers to the right person, averaging over speakers so that minor speakers count as much as dominant ones.
blocks.zh:
SFT的下个切入目标逐个地模仿了参考标题符号,而没有直接测量预测的时间戳和扬声器任务的准确性.
因此,我们通过强化学习(RL)[91]进一步优化DiaCap,利用精细反馈作为奖励。
RL数据由大约2.9K个人修正的片段组成,这些片段来自视觉上具有挑战性的场景,如多人场景,小或模糊相貌,以及延迟扬声器外观等.
我们的奖励不是将不同的错误类型混为一谈,而是分解成三个术语。
时间戳奖励按每个预测的语句边界与参考的距离来计分.
对于分化,一个描述-不可知的分组奖励检查每个人的言论是否共用一个预测的演说者,惩罚分裂一个人和合并几个人。
然后,一项有约束力的奖励会问一名多式联运法官,每种预测的描述是否指正确的人,平均比发言者多,因此,未成年发言者与主要发言者一样多。

blocks.en:
Considering that transcription rarely relies on visual cues [ 85 , 18 , 53 ] , DiaCap takes off-the-shelf transcripts by default and focuses on diarization and timestamping.
We also train DiaCap-E2E, an end-to-end variant that outputs the complete dialogue caption directly.
We evaluate on DiaDemBench [ 8 ] , which we extend with utterance-level timestamps and subtitle redaction for more rigorous assessment.
Experimental results show that both models perform strongly, with DiaCap using transcripts from an off-the-shelf recognizer and DiaCap-E2E predicting its own.
Specifically, DiaCap performs on par with Gemini 4 Argon [ 26 ] in audiovisual diarization while substantially outperforming it in timestamp accuracy (76.59 vs . 42.76 TIME).
Beyond DiaDemBench, DiaCap maintains strong diarization on multilingual videos, including languages underrepresented in its training data, and on minute-long videos [ 72 ] . It also shows promising transfer to audiovisual question answering [ 57 ] .
blocks.zh:
考虑到抄写很少依赖视觉提示[85,18,53],DiaCap默认地取出现成的抄本,并专注于对号和时间戳.
我们还培训DiaCap-E2E,这是一个直接输出完整对话框标题的端到端变体。
我们评价DiaDem Bench [8] ,我们用语音级别的时间戳和字幕编辑来进行更严格的评估。
实验结果表明两种模型都表现很强,DiaCap使用现成的识别器发出的记录誊本,DiaCap-E2E预测它自己.
具体而言,DiaCap在视听分化方面与双子座4 Argon [26] 同等表现,同时在时间戳准确度方面却大大地超过了它(76.59对42.76 Time)。
DiaCap除了DiaDem Bench之外,在多语种视频上保持了强烈的分化,包括在其培训数据中代表不足的语言,以及在一分钟的视频上[72]. 它还显示向视听问题的转让很有希望[57]。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Speaker diarization predicts who speaks each word or utterance.
Audio-only methods partition speech by speaker using voice characteristics alone [ 1 , 59 ] , through embedding clustering [ 43 , 69 , 76 , 92 ] , end-to-end prediction [ 21 , 28 , 62 ] , hybrid systems [ 4 , 36 ] , or joint recognition and diarization [ 17 , 34 , 35 , 55 , 60 , 61 , 90 , 77 ] .
We focus on audiovisual diarization, which must also link each utterance to a visible person.
Audiovisual methods associate speech with faces via synchrony [ 13 , 16 , 33 , 58 ] and active speaker detection [ 38 , 45 , 47 , 54 , 66 , 74 , 78 ] to diarize [ 5 , 9 , 12 , 24 , 31 , 49 , 83 ] , but still output anonymous clusters or face tracks.
Methods that name speakers require prior identity information, either cast galleries [ 19 , 56 , 39 , 32 ] or predefined appearance descriptions [ 2 ] .
DiaCap instead generates a visual description of each speaker from the video and links every utterance to that person.
blocks.zh:
扬声器的分化预示着谁说出每个词或说话.
唯音法 分区发言 单独使用语音特性 [1,59],通过嵌入组合 [43, 69., 76, 92],端到端预测 [21, 28, 62], 混合系统 [4, 36], 或联合识别和分化 [17, 34, 35, 55, 60, 61, 90, 77].
我们把重点放在视听的分化上,这种分化还必须将每个言论与一个可见的人联系起来。
视听方法通过同步 [13, 16, 33, 58] 和主动扬声器检测[38, 45, 47, 54, 66, 74, 78] 将语音与面相相关联,以对接 [5, 9, 12, 24, 31, 49, 83],但仍输出匿名的集群或面相轨.
说出名字的方法需要事先提供身份资料,或者铸造画廊[19、56、39、32],或者预先确定外观描述[2]。
DiaCap转而从视频中生成每个发言者的可视化描述,并链接到每个人的每句话。

blocks.en:
Temporal localization determines when each word or utterance is spoken.
Timestamps are typically obtained by aligning transcripts to audio [ 3 , 42 , 52 ] , including with LLM-based forced aligners [ 68 ] , or generated by audio-language models as timestamped captions [ 41 ] or word-level annotations of given transcripts [ 37 ] .
In video, moment retrieval [ 22 , 27 , 44 ] and dense event captioning [ 40 , 86 ] have led to video and audiovisual LLMs that predict temporal boundaries [ 11 , 30 , 65 , 73 , 79 ] , but these localize queried moments or scene events rather than individual utterances.
Only a few audiovisual LLMs output utterance-level timestamps [ 72 , 26 , 64 ] , and these remain coarse.
DiaCap targets this utterance-level setting, predicting the boundaries of each utterance together with its speaker.
blocks.zh:
时间本地化决定每个词或语句何时被说出.
时间戳通常是通过对录音[3,42,52]进行校正,包括使用基于LLM的强制对接器[68],或者通过音频语言模型生成的时间戳字幕[41]或给定的录音记录的词级说明[37]来获得的.
在视频中,瞬间检索[22、27、44]和密集事件字幕[40、86]导致视频和视听LLMs预测时间界限[11、30、65、73、79],但这些内容将被询问的瞬间或场景事件本地化,而不是个别的言论。
只有几个视听的LLMS输出了语音级别时间戳[72,26,64],这些内容仍然粗糙.
DiaCap针对这种语音级别设定,与发音一起预测每个语音的边界.

blocks.en:
Audiovisual dialogue captioning. General-purpose audiovisual LLMs, including Qwen-Omni [ 64 , 84 , 85 ] , Gemini [ 14 , 26 , 25 ] , and others [ 10 , 20 , 70 , 82 , 89 , 93 ] , can generate transcripts, speaker descriptions, and timestamps from synchronized video and audio.
Detailed audiovisual captioners improve content coverage and audiovisual correspondence [ 6 , 7 , 23 , 48 , 51 , 71 , 81 , 67 , 80 ] , and structured script generators organize scenes, characters, events, and dialogue into timestamped outputs [ 63 , 75 , 88 ] .
Most relevant to us are the dialogue captioners, such as DiaDem [ 8 ] and D-ORCA [ 72 ] , whose speaker attribution still trails strong general-purpose audiovisual LLMs. Moreover, DiaDem does not output timestamps, and D-ORCA outputs only whole-second ones.
DiaCap fills this gap, which matches the speaker attribution of the strongest general-purpose audiovisual LLMs while producing the most accurate utterance timestamps.
blocks.zh:
视听对话字幕。 通用视听LLM,包括Quen-Omni [64, 84, 85],双子座 [14, 26, 25]等[10, 20, 70, 82, 89, 93],可以生成记录誊本,扬声器描述,以及同步视频和音频的时间戳.
详细的视听字幕改进了内容覆盖范围和视听通信[6、7、23、48、51、71、81、67、80],结构化脚本生成器将场景、人物、事件和对话组织成时间标出的产出[63、75、88]。
与我们最相关的是对话标题,如DiaDem[8]和D-ORCA[72],其发言者的归属仍然有很强的通用视听课程。 此外,DiaDem不输出时间戳,D-ORCA只输出一整秒时间戳.
DiaCap填补了这一空白,这与最强的通用视听课程的演讲者归属相吻合,同时产生了最准确的语音时间戳。

blocks.en: 3 Dialogue Captioning
blocks.zh: 3 对话框说明

blocks.en:
Given a video V V and its audio track A A , dialogue captioning aims to produce a caption Y Y consisting of a list of utterances and a list of speakers ( Fig. 2 ).
Each utterance is a continuous segment of speech from a single speaker, annotated with its transcript, start and end timestamps, and speaker label.
The label points to an entry in the speaker list, where each speaker is described by visual appearance ( e.g . , “a man in a blue shirt”) so that they can be matched to a person in the video.
In this paper, we refer to predicting the utterance-level timestamps as utterance timing, and to building the speaker list and assigning each utterance to a speaker as audiovisual diarization.
blocks.zh:
由于视频V及其音频音轨A .A, 对话字幕旨在制作一个字幕Y Y, 包括一个语音表和发言者名单(图2)。
每句话都是单个发言者发言的连续部分,附有发言记录、开始和结束时间戳和发言者标签。
标签指向发言者名单上的一个条目,其中每个发言者通过视觉外观(例如“穿蓝色衬衫的人”)来描述,以便与视频中的人相配。
在本文中,我们提到将发言级别的时间戳作为发言时间的预测,并提到建立发言者名单,将每个发言分配给一个发言者,作为视听分化。

blocks.en: 3.1 Pipeline Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 管道概况

blocks.en:
Transcript-conditioned pipeline. Transcription is well served by strong off-the-shelf speech recognizers [ 85 , 18 , 53 , 26 ] , whereas timestamps and diarization remain the main bottlenecks of current dialogue captioning.
We therefore separate transcription from the rest of the task, which lets us reuse these recognizers and focus our model on predicting audiovisual diarization and precise timestamps.
blocks.zh:
转写有条件的管道。 现成的语音识别器[85、18、53、26]对译名很有帮助,而时间戳和数字化仍然是当前对话标题的主要瓶颈。
因此,我们把抄录与任务的其他部分分开,这样我们就能重新使用这些识别器,并将我们的模型集中于预测视听分化和准确的时间戳。

The transcript T T is a single text that covers all speech in the clip, without utterance boundaries, timestamps, or speaker labels.
Given T T , the model 𝚯 \boldsymbol{\Theta} splits it into utterances, predicts their timestamps, and diarizes them.

blocks.en: 3.2 Supervised Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 3.2 监督罚款

blocks.en:
Figure 3 : Training data curation and annotation. (1) Audio, audiovisual, and visual experts tag each clip.
We remove clips with unrelated or out-of-sync audio, deduplicate and resample the rest to balance language, speaker count, and visual scenes, and add no-speech clips with empty targets.
(2) An audiovisual LLM annotates who says what, and a speech aligner timestamps each utterance.
(3) Human annotators correct hard clips mined from the SFT corpus, plus fewer single-speaker clips, to form the RL corpus.
blocks.zh:
图3:培训数据整理和注释。 (1) 音频、视听和视觉专家对每个片段进行标记。
我们删除不相关或超音速的片段,去除并重取其余部分,以平衡语言,扬声器计数,以及视觉场景,并添加有空目标的无声片段.
(2) 一个视听的LLM注释,谁说什么,以及每句话都有一个语音标出时间戳。
(3) 人类注释员纠正从SFT体中挖掘出来的硬相片,加上较少的单声道片来组成RL体.

blocks.en:
SFT requires a large and diverse set of videos with complete dialogue captions ( i.e . , transcripts, timestamps, and audiovisual diarization).
To the best of our knowledge, no public dataset provides such annotations at scale, and no single existing model produces them reliably.
We therefore build the SFT corpus from raw videos through data curation and synthetic annotation ( Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh:
SFT需要一套大而多样的视频,配有完整的对话字幕(即:笔录,时间戳和视听分化).
就我们所知,没有公共数据集提供这种规模的说明,也没有一个现有的单一模型可靠地提供。
因此,我们通过数据整理和合成注释(图3),用原始视频制作SFT体。

blocks.en: Data curation. We curate an audiovisually aligned and balanced set of clips in four steps ( Fig. 3 , step 1).
blocks.zh: 数据整理. 我们分四个步骤(图3,步骤1)整理一套视听一致和平衡的剪辑。

blocks.en:
Tagging. We start from an in-house collection of about 1.25M clips of 4 to 30s, most of which are cut from longer videos.
For the audio, pyannote.audio [ 62 , 4 ] diarizes the speech and provides the number of speakers and the amount of overlapped speech, and the language is taken from the metadata of the collection.
For the audiovisual correspondence, Synchformer [ 33 ] predicts a relatedness score r r , which indicates whether the sound is produced by the visible content, and the offset δ \delta between the audio and the video.
For the visual content, we track and cluster faces to count the visible people, and LR-ASD [ 46 ] detects which of them are speaking.
blocks.zh:
缠来缠去. 我们从内部收集的大约1.25M的4到30个剪辑开始,这些剪辑大多取自较长的视频.
对于音频,pyannote.audio [62, 4] 将语音分化,并提供发音的数量和重复发音的数量,语言取自所收录的元数据.
对于视听通信,Synchformer [33] 预测一个相關分數r r r 表示声音是否由可见内容所出,而相關分數由相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相關相相關相相關相相相相相相相相相相相相相關相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

blocks.en:
Audiovisual filtering. We keep a clip only if r > 0.3 r>0.3 and | δ | < 0.5 |\delta|<0.5 s, which removes clips whose audio is unrelated to the frames, such as voice-overs, and clips whose audio is out of sync so that lip motion cannot be matched to the speech.
The filter keeps about 80% of the pool.
We do not require a visible or speaking face, since off-screen speakers are part of the task and are described by voice alone.
blocks.zh:
视听过滤. 只有在r > 0.3 r > 0.3和 | < < 0.5 delta > 0.5 s时,我们才保留一个剪辑,删除其音频与帧无关的剪辑,如语音翻音等,并删除其音频不同步的剪辑,使口语运动无法与语音相匹配.
过滤器保存了约80%的池子.
我们不需要一个醒目的或说话的面孔,因为非屏幕发言者是这项任务的一部分,仅用声音来描述。

blocks.en:
Deduplication and resampling. The filtered pool is highly imbalanced ( e.g . , English and Mandarin account for about 70% of the clips, and only 16% have three or more speakers).
We first remove duplicate windows from the same source video and cap their number of clips, so that a few long videos do not dominate.
We then draw a stratified sample that balances, in order of priority, the language over 18 target languages, the number of speakers, the clip duration, the amount of overlapped speech, and the numbers of visible and speaking faces.
The last two factors retain the rare clips with overlapping speech or several visible people, on which diarization is most difficult.
blocks.zh:
分相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 被过滤池高度失衡(如:英语和普通话约占剪辑的70%,只有16%有3个或更多发音).
我们首先从同源视频中去掉重复的窗口,并限制其剪辑数量,这样少数长视频就不会占主导地位.
然后我们绘制一个分级的样本,按优先顺序平衡18种目标语言以上的语言、发言者人数、剪辑时间、重复发言的数量以及可见和说话面孔的数量。
后两个因素保留了少有的片段与相重叠的语音或几个能见的人,在这些片段上,分化最为困难.

blocks.en:
No-speech clips. The zero-speaker stratum provides clips without speech, such as clips with only music, ambient sound, or silence.
These clips skip annotation and receive empty targets, so that the model learns not to hallucinate dialogue.
The final corpus contains about 225K clips (189K with speech and 36K without speech) with a total duration of 1,175 hours. Appendix A shows its distributions of speaker count and language.
blocks.zh:
无相相相相相相相相相相. 零声道提供没有语音的片段,如只有音乐的片段,环境声音,或沉默.
这些片段跳过注释并接收空出的目标,使模型学会不产生幻觉的对话.
最终的教程包含约225K个剪辑(189K有语音,36K没有语音),总长度为1,175小时. 附 录 A显示其演讲者数和语言的分布.

blocks.en:
Synthetic annotation. Human annotation at this scale is costly and time-consuming, especially for diarization.
We therefore build a synthetic annotation pipeline that combines two complementary models ( Fig. 3 , step 2).
An audiovisual LLM ( e.g . , Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 25 ] ) gives accurate transcripts and diarization, but its timestamps remain coarse even with careful prompting.
A speech aligner, TAC [ 41 ] , localizes speech precisely but cannot see the speakers.
The audiovisual LLM first annotates the transcript, utterance segmentation, speaker list, speaker assignments, and attributes.
TAC then refines the timestamps of each utterance while keeping the rest of the annotation, and clips that fail the alignment are discarded.
This combination substantially improves TIME from 23.54 to 72.42 over Gemini 3.1 Pro alone, while keeping its transcripts and diarization ( Tab. 1 ).
We use the pipeline as an offline data engine, but chaining several models and a proprietary LLM makes it too expensive for everyday use.
blocks.zh:
合成注释. 这种规模的人类注释成本高而耗时,特别是用于对等化.
因此,我们建立了一个合成注释管道,将两个互补模型(图3,步骤2)结合起来。
视听LLM(如:双子座 3.1 Pro [25])给出了准确的文字记录和分化,但其时标即使小心地提示,仍然粗糙.
TAC [41] 的语音校对者准确地将语音本地化,但不能看到发言者。
视听的LLM首先标出记录稿、发言段、发言者名单、演讲者任务和属性。
TAC随后在保留其余注释的同时细化了每句话的时间戳,并丢弃了未能对齐的片段.
双子座3.1相比时间从23.54提高到72.42 独行其事,同时保留其笔录并进行分解(表1)。
我们使用管道作为离线数据引擎, 但连锁几个模型和一个专有的LLM, 使得它太昂贵, 日常使用。

blocks.en:
Hard-case mining and annotation. We focus on three types of visually difficult scenes, namely
(1) multi-person scenes , where several faces remain visible while only one person speaks,
(2) limited visual evidence , where the speaker’s mouth movements are difficult to observe due to low resolution, blur, occlusion, or unfavorable viewing angles; and
(3) delayed speaker appearance , where speech begins while a non-speaking person is shown on screen, and the actual speaker only becomes visible later.
We retrieve clips of each type from the SFT corpus with rules on their video tags and synthetic annotations ( e.g . , face and speaker counts), and add a smaller set of single-speaker clips to avoid biasing the policy toward extra speakers, which yields about 2.9K clips ( Fig. 3 , step 3).
To obtain reliable references Y ∗ Y^{\ast} on these clips, human annotators correct the synthetic annotation of each clip against the video, fixing the speaker list, reassigning utterances, completing missing speech, and adjusting timestamps.
blocks.zh:
硬案挖掘与注释. 我们侧重于三种类型的视觉困难场景,即:
(一) 多人场景,其中几个面孔仍然可见,只有一个人说话,
(2) 有限的视觉证据,即发言者的口腔动作由于分辨率低、模糊、被遮住或看不清而难以观察;
(3)延迟扬声器外出,在屏幕上显示非说人时开始讲话,实际扬声器只在后期才显出.
我们从SFT体中取回每种类型的片段,并附有其视频标记和合成说明的规则(例如:面部和扬声器计数),并增加一套更小的单声道片段来避免政策偏向于额外的扬声器,从而产生大约2.9K片段(图3,步骤3)。
为了在这些短片上获得可靠的参考,人类的注释者会对照视频更正每个短片的合成注释,确定演讲者名单,重新分配言论,完成缺失的演讲,并调整时间戳.

blocks.en:
Reward design. A sampled caption Y ^ \hat{Y} and the reference Y ∗ Y^{\ast} may split the speech into different utterances, so we first match them at the word level.
Since both captions contain nearly the same words, we align their word sequences by edit distance, using characters instead of words for CJK languages.
Each reference word is thus mapped to the predicted utterance that contains it, which gives its predicted speaker and timestamps.

由于两个标题都包含几乎相同的单词,我们通过编辑距离来调整它们的单词序列,使用字符而不是CJK语言的单词.
每个参考词因此被映射到其中的预言中,从而给出了预言的发音和时间戳.

blocks.en:
Timestamp reward. For each start and end time of a reference utterance, we take the corresponding predicted boundary and assign a credit of one if the error is within 0.3s, decreasing linearly to zero at 1s.
A prediction may merge two consecutive reference utterances and thus miss the boundary between them.
We give zero credit to such a missing boundary only if it marks a speaker change or a pause of at least 0.5s, so that merging continuous speech of one speaker is not penalized.
Extra predicted boundaries inside a reference utterance are not scored. R time R_{\text{time}} is the mean credit over all scored boundaries.

预测可能会合并两个连续的参考语句,从而错过它们之间的边界.

Policy optimization. We optimize 𝚯 \boldsymbol{\Theta} and 𝚯 E2E \boldsymbol{\Theta}_{\text{E2E}} with DAPO [ 91 ] , initialized from the SFT model.
For each clip, we sample a group of eight captions and compute the advantage of each caption as its reward minus the group mean, which raises the likelihood of captions that outperform the group average.
Following Dr. GRPO [ 50 ] , we do not normalize the advantages by the group standard deviation, since this normalization overweights clips whose captions differ only slightly in reward.
As in DAPO, we discard groups with identical rewards, which provide no learning signal, and apply a soft penalty to overlong responses.

blocks.en:
Benchmarks. We evaluate on DiaDemBench [ 8 ] , which contains 1,039 video clips whose utterances are each annotated with a transcript and a natural-language description of the speaker.
Since DiaDem provides no timestamps, we manually annotate the start and end times of every utterance, and DiaDemBench hereafter refers to the benchmark with these timestamps.
To prevent models from exploiting the burned-in subtitles for transcription, we further detect the subtitles in every frame with PP-OCRv5 [ 15 ] and blur the detected regions, leaving the audio and annotations unchanged, which affects 598 of the 1039 clips.
We refer to this subtitle-redacted version as DiaDemBench-NoSub and report all results on it unless noted otherwise.
blocks.zh:
基准。 我们评价DiaDem Bench[8],其中包含1 039个录像片段,每个片段附有记录和发言者的自然语言描述。
由于 DiaDem 不提供时间戳, 我们手动注释了每句话的开始和结束时间, DiaDem Bench 以下提到这些时间戳的基准。
为防止模特利用被烧毁的字幕来进行转录,我们进一步检测出每帧中带有PP-OCRv5 [15]的字幕并模糊被检测出的区域,使音频和说明保持不变,这影响了1039个片段中的598个.
我们称这个字幕编辑的版本为DiaDem Bench-NoSub,除非另有说明,否则报告所有结果。

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. We adopt the REF and ASR metrics of DiaDemBench [ 8 ] and introduce TIME to evaluate timestamps. REF measures whether each utterance is attributed to the correct speaker, as judged by Gemini-2.5-Flash. ASR measures the transcription accuracy of the matched utterances. TIME measures whether both the start and end times of each matched utterance are within 0.3s of the reference.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度。 我们采用DiaDem Bench的REF和ASR衡量标准,并引入时间来评估时间戳。 如双子座-2.5-Flash判断,REF衡量每句话是否归于正确的扬声器. ASR测量对应语句的抄录精度. 时间测量每句话的起止时间是否在参考文献的0.3以内。

blocks.en:
Baselines. We compare DiaCap with state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight models, all evaluated by us with their official implementations.
General-purpose audiovisual LLMs ( e.g . , Gemini 3.1 Pro) receive our prompt, which requests every field of the caption.
Dialogue captioners ( e.g . , DiaDem) use their official prompts, and a text-only extractor [ 14 ] converts their free-form captions into dialogues.
We also report the annotation pipeline that produces the synthetic labels of DiaCap ( Sec. 3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
基线。 我们把DiaCap与最先进的专有型和开放型模型进行比较,这些模型都由我们根据其正式实施情况加以评估。
通用视听LLMS(例如双子座3.1 Pro)收到我们的提示,它要求每个标题领域。
对话框字幕器( 如 diaDem) 使用其正式提示, 且仅文本的提取器 [ 14] 将其自由格式字幕转换为对话框 。
我们还报告生产DiaCap合成标签的注解管道(第3.2节)。

blocks.en:
Evaluation protocol. We report results under two settings.
In the Predicted-transcript setting, no ground-truth text is given, so the baselines transcribe the speech themselves, whereas DiaCap takes the transcript from an off-the-shelf speech recognizer.
In the GT-transcript setting, models additionally receive the ground-truth transcript as a single unsegmented text, which removes transcription errors and isolates diarization and timestamps.
blocks.zh:
评估协议。 我们在两种情况下报告结果。
在预想的文字设定中,没有给出地面真实的文字,因此基线会自行翻录演讲内容,而DiaCap则从现成的语音识别器中取取出笔录.
在GT-transcript设定中,模型作为单一的无分块文字额外接收地真文字,这可以去除抄录错误并隔离分化和时间戳.

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en:
Model architecture. We build DiaCap and DiaCap-E2E on Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking [ 85 ] .
We apply LoRA [ 29 ] with rank 512 and α = 1024 \alpha=1024 to the attention projections of the LLM, and freeze the experts, the router, and the audio and vision encoders.
Each video is resized so that its short edge is at most 360 pixels, preserving its aspect ratio, and is sampled at 4 frames per second.
blocks.zh:
模型建筑. 我们建造了"DiaCap"和"DiaCap-E2E"在"Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking [85].
我们对LLM的注意力预测应用512分和α=1024分的LORA [29],并冻结专家,路由器,音频和视觉编码器.
每段视频的大小被调整,使其短边最高为360像素,保持了宽相比,并被取样为每秒4帧.

blocks.en:
SFT training. We train 𝚯 \boldsymbol{\Theta} and 𝚯 E2E \boldsymbol{\Theta}_{\text{E2E}} on the 225K clips labeled by our synthetic pipeline, which uses Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 25 ] as its audiovisual LLM. The data is formatted correspondingly to the required input output of both models.
We use AdamW with β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 and β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 , and a peak learning rate of 6 × 10 − 5 6\times 10^{-5} with 100 warmup steps and cosine decay over 2 epochs.
Training uses a global batch size of 128 on 16 NVIDIA B200 GPUs, and we select the checkpoint after 1.5 epochs.

SFT训练. 在用双子座 3.1 Pro [25] 作为其视听LLM 标注的 225K 合成管道上, 数据格式与两个模型所需的输入输出相对应。
我们使用 AdamW 的 β 1 = 0.9\β 1\β + 0.9 和β 2 = 0.95\β +β 2\ + 0.95 , 峰值学习率为 6× 10 − 5\ 6\ 时为 10\ + 5 } 由 100 个取暖步骤和 余弦衰减 超过 2 个历程 。
训练在16个NVIDIA B200 GPU上使用128个全球批量大小,我们在1.5个纪元后选择了检查站.

blocks.en:
RL training. After SFT, we further train 𝚯 \boldsymbol{\Theta} and 𝚯 E2E \boldsymbol{\Theta}_{\text{E2E}} with DAPO [ 91 ] on the 2.9K human-corrected clips.
We use a global batch size of 32 clips and each clip has 8 rollouts. We train with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} for 100 steps for 𝚯 \boldsymbol{\Theta} and 60 steps for 𝚯 E2E \boldsymbol{\Theta}_{\text{E2E}} .
The binding reward uses Gemini-2.5-Flash [ 14 ] as its judge.

blocks.en:
Inference. In the Predicted-transcript setting, DiaCap uses Qwen3-Omni-Captioner [ 85 ] as its speech recognizer 𝚿 \boldsymbol{\Psi} unless noted otherwise, whereas DiaCap-E2E predicts the transcript itself.
In the GT-transcript setting, DiaCap directly takes the GT transcript instead.
blocks.zh:
推论. DiaCap在预设-transcript设定中,使用Qune3-Omni-Captioner [85] 作为其语音识别器 \\\ boldsymbol\ 除非另有说明,而DiaCap-E2E则预测笔录本身.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Qualitative comparison with similar-looking speakers. Each track shows one model’s predicted utterances over time, colored by the ground-truth speaker that its description depicts, with wrong speakers outlined in dark red.
blocks.zh: 图4:与相类似发言者的定性比较。 每个音轨都显示一个模型的预测语句随着时间推移而变化,其色彩取自其描述的地上真言演说者,而用暗红色描述错误的演说者。

blocks.en: 4.3 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 主要成果

blocks.en:
Tab. 1 compares DiaCap with state-of-the-art models. We discuss the results on DiaDemBench-NoSub (✗ columns). Comparison with open-weight models. DiaDem, the best open-weight model, does not predict timestamps, and DiaCap outperforms it by + + 7.91 REF, with DiaCap-E2E close behind.
Among the models that predict timestamps, the best TIME is only 22.52 (Qwen3-Omni-Thinking), while both of our models exceed 76.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 1将DiaCap与最先进的模型进行比较. 我们讨论关于DiaDem Bench-NoSub(XXXX栏)的结果。 与开放量级模型的比较. DiaDem是最佳的开放量级模型,不预测时间戳,DiaCap比它表现优于++7.91REF,DiaCap-E2E紧跟后方.
在预测时间戳的模型中,最好的TIME只有22.52(Qune3-Omni-Thinking),而我们两个模型都超过了76.

blocks.en:
Comparison with proprietary models. In the Predicted-transcript setting, both of our models outperform Gemini 4 Argon in all three metrics, most notably by over + + 33 TIME.
DiaCap also outperforms the annotation pipeline that produces its SFT labels by + + 2.52 REF, + + 2.42 ASR, and + + 4.17 TIME, and DiaCap-E2E by similar margins.
blocks.zh:
与专有模型的比较. 在预想-图文设定中,我们两个模型在所有三个度量中都超过了双子座4Argon,最显著的是超过+33时间.
DiaCap还比生产其 SFT 标签的注解管道表现优于+ 2.52 REF,+ 2.42 ASR,和+ + 4.17 Time, 和 DiaCap-E2E的相近边距.

blocks.en:
GT-transcript setting. We evaluate only DiaCap, as DiaCap-E2E does not take a transcript as input.
DiaCap matches Gemini 4 Argon in REF (81.05 vs . 80.87), leads by + + 40.68 TIME, and outperforms its base model by + + 25.77 REF.
With GT transcripts, every model’s REF rises, so transcription quality strongly affects diarization.
blocks.zh:
GT-transcript 设置 。 我们只评价DiaCap,因为DiaCap-E2E不采用笔录作为输入.
DiaCap在REF(81.05 vs. 80.87)中与双子座4Argon相匹配,由++ 40.68 Time领先,以++ 25.77 REF超越其基准模型.
有了GT的笔录,每个模型的REF都上升了,因此笔录的质量会强烈地影响对等化.

blocks.en:
Effect of RL. RL lifts the Predicted-transcript REF of DiaCap by + + 3.12, from below Gemini 3.1 Pro to the highest among all models.
DiaCap-E2E starts from a stronger SFT model and gains less in REF, but RL improves all three of its metrics and gives the best open-weight ASR and TIME.
blocks.zh:
RL.RL的效果使DiaCap的预想-特写REF由++ 3.12,从双子座3.1 Pro以下升至所有型号中最高.
DiaCap-E2E起自更强的SFT模型并减少REF的得分,但RL改进了它的所有三个度量,给出了最好的开放量ASR和Time.

blocks.en:
Qualitative results. Fig. 4 shows an example with three speakers, two of whom wear similar military helmets.
Gemini 4 Argon misattributes the utterance and hallucinates an extra one, and DiaDem describes only two of the three speakers.
DiaCap distinguishes the two similar-looking speakers, attributing and timing all four utterances correctly (clip-level TIME of 100 vs . 44 for Gemini 4 Argon).
More qualitative examples are provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
定性结果. 图4举出一例,有3名发言者,其中2人戴着类似的军用头盔。
双子座4 Argon错配了语音,并产生一个额外的幻觉,而DiaDem只描述了三个发音中的两个.
DiaCap区分了两个相貌相近的扬声器,将所有四个发音都正确归属和定时(clip-level Time of 100 vs. 44 for Bemini 4 Argon).
附录E提供了更多的定性实例。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 2 : Transcript-conditioned vs . end-to-end prediction. DiaCap-E2E predicts the transcript itself; DiaCap takes transcripts from speech recognizers without retraining. Both are trained with SFT + RL. ∗ Default recognizer.
blocks.zh: 表2 : 转写条件与.端到端的预测. DiaCap-E2E预测笔录本身; DiaCap从语音识别器取出笔录而无需再培训. 两者都经过了SFT + RL. *默认识别器的训练.

blocks.en: Unless noted otherwise, all ablations use the Predicted-transcript setting on DiaDemBench-NoSub.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,所有浮雕都使用DiaDem Bench-NoSub上的预设-图文设置。

blocks.en:
Effect of subtitles. We also evaluate all models on the original DiaDemBench videos with burned-in subtitles (✓ columns in Tab. 1 ).
Many baselines improve markedly in the Predicted-transcript setting by reading the dialogue from the subtitles ( e.g . , + + 4.44 ASR and + + 2.63 REF for Gemini 4 Argon), and DiaCap-E2E, which also transcribes speech itself.
These gains disappear with GT transcripts ( e.g . , 80.87 vs . 80.67 REF for Gemini 4 Argon), confirming that the subtitles mainly help transcription.
In contrast, DiaCap changes by less than 0.2 in all metrics, as it takes the audio-only off-the-shelf transcript.
We therefore recommend DiaDemBench-NoSub, a stricter but fairer setting that requires transcribing speech rather than exploiting subtitles.
blocks.zh:
字幕的效果。 我们还评估了原版DiaDem Bench录像上所有带有被烧毁字幕的模型(Tab栏目)。 (第1条)
许多基线通过从字幕(例如:++ 4.44 ASR和++ 2.63 REF为双子座4 Argon)和DiaCap-E2E读取语音本身,在预测-transcript设定中明显改善。
这些收益会随着GT的笔录而消失(例如:80.87 vs 80.67 REF for Bemini 4 Argon),证实字幕主要有助于笔录.
相形之下, DiaCap 在所有度量衡中变化小于0.2,因为它需要只用音频的现成记录.
因此,我们建议DiaDem Bench-NoSub, 这是一种更严格、更公平的设定,

blocks.en:
Transcript conditioning. We compare DiaCap with DiaCap-E2E, both trained with SFT + RL, to test how an off-the-shelf transcript affects the caption ( Tab. 2 ).
With the default Qwen3-Omni-Captioner, the two models perform comparably: DiaCap-E2E achieves higher ASR ( + + 0.56), while REF and TIME differ by less than 0.11.
Since DiaCap takes the transcript as input, it can use other speech recognizers [ 85 , 18 , 53 , 26 ] without retraining.
Its TIME increases with the recognizer’s ASR, from 74.68 to 78.93 as ASR rises from 78.23 to 81.23, and with MAI-Transcribe-2, the strongest recognizer, it reaches the best results in Tab. 2 .
blocks.zh:
转写条件。 我们比较DiaCap和DiaCap-E2E,两者都经过了SFT + RL的训练,以测试现成的笔录对标题的影响(Tab. 2 )。
以默认的Qune3-Omni-Captioner,两个模型的性能相仿: DiaCap-E2E实现较高的ASR(++0.56),而REF和Time的相差小于0.11.
由于DiaCap将笔录作为输入,它可以使用其他语音识别器[85,18,53,26]而不进行再培训.
它的时间随着识别器的ASR而增加,从74.68增加到78.93,因为ASR从78.23增加到81.23,而随着MAI-Trancis-2,它是最强的识别器,它在Tab中达到了最佳效果. 2 (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en:
RL data. We test whether hard-case mining and human review improve the RL data of DiaCap, compared with randomly sampled clips and automatic labels ( Tab. 3 ).
With the same automatic labels, mined clips outperform random ones by + + 0.43 REF and + + 0.79 TIME.
Human review of the mined labels adds a further + + 1.38 REF and + + 0.44 TIME, for a total gain of + + 1.81 REF and + + 1.23 TIME over random clips with automatic labels.
blocks.zh:
RL数据. 与随机抽取的片段和自动标签(Tab.
使用相同的自动标签,被开采的夹片会以++0.43REF和++0.79 Time来比随机的多出.
对被开采的标签进行人文审查后,会再增加++1.38REF和++0.44 Time,总收益为++1.81REF和++ 1.23 Time 超过带有自动标签的随机片段.

blocks.zh: 表3:RL数据对DiaCap的影响。 所有变体都从同一个SFT检查站开始,使用我们的奖励如Eq. 6.

blocks.zh: 表4:RL奖励对DiaCap的影响。 两个奖项都以相同的经人审查的被布雷的剪辑进行训练,并在RL 第100步进行评价;阴影行是我们的奖项(第6段)。

blocks.en:
RL reward design. We compare our decomposed reward with a baseline that replaces the grouping and binding rewards with REF [ 8 ] ( Tab. 4 ) on DiaCap.
Although the baseline directly optimizes REF, our reward outperforms it by + + 1.30 REF and + + 0.67 TIME, and improves REF over SFT by + + 3.12 instead of + + 1.82.
We attribute this mainly to the binding reward, which weights every speaker equally, whereas REF is dominated by frequent speakers and gives little credit for correctly attributing minor ones.
blocks.zh:
RL奖励设计. 我们把我们被分解的奖励与一个基线进行比较,该基准用DiaCap上的REF[8](Tab. 4)来取而代之,并用约束性的奖励来取而代之.
虽然基线直接优化了REF,但我们的奖励表现却比它高出了++ 1.30REF和++ 0.67时间,并将REF比SFT改进为++ 3.12而不是+ 1.82.
我们将此主要归因于具有约束力的奖励,这种奖励对每个发言者都具有同等的份量,而可再生能源论坛则由频繁的发言者所主导,对正确划分次要发言者的分量几乎没有什么赞扬。

blocks.en: 4.5 Generalization
blocks.zh: 4.5 概论

blocks.en:
Multilingual videos. Since DiaDemBench mostly covers English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean, we curate a multilingual benchmark to evaluate DiaCap on more languages.
It contains 140 clips in 14 languages, with burned-in subtitles redacted as in DiaDemBench-NoSub.
Ten of these languages are well represented in our SFT and RL data, whereas Vietnamese, Thai, Persian, and Burmese are underrepresented (at most 0.25% of SFT data).
For the ground truth, we keep the clips on which Gemini, MAI-Transcribe-2, and Scribe v2 agree on the transcript, and manually correct the speaker descriptions, assignments, and timestamps.
We evaluate in the GT-transcript setting.
As shown in Tab. 5 , DiaCap reaches 71.67 REF and 91.45 TIME, well ahead of MiMo-V2.6-Flash and Qwen3-Omni-Thinking, and completes every clip, whereas MiMo-V2.6-Flash falls into repetitive loops on 38 of 140 clips.
This suggests that DiaCap’s diarization and timing generalize well across languages.
blocks.zh:
多语种视频. 由于DiaDem Bench主要涵盖英文、中文、日文和韩文,
包含140个14个语言的剪辑,并有DiaDem Bench-NoSub所编辑的被烧毁的字幕.
其中10种语言在我国的SFT和RL数据中得到很好的体现,而越南语、泰语、波斯语和缅甸语的代表性不足(在SFT数据中占到0.25%)。
关于地面真相,我们保留了双子座,MAI-Trancis-2和Scribe v2就笔录达成一致的剪辑,并手动更正了演讲者描述,任务和时间戳.
我们用GT标记来评估
如塔布所显示. 5,DiaCap达到71.67 REF和91.45 Time,远远领先于MiMo-V2.6-Flash和Qune3-Omni-Thinking,并完成每段剪辑,而MiMo-V2.6-Flash则在140个剪辑中的38个被反复循环.
这说明DiaCap的分化和时间安排在各种语言中都非常普遍。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Dialogue captioning in 14 languages (GT-transcript setting). #Completed excludes clips on which a model degenerates into repetitive loops, indicating that it handles the language poorly. REF and TIME are computed on completed clips.
blocks.zh: 表5:14种语言的对话字幕(GT-transcript set). #完成的排除了一个模型退化成重复循环的片段,表明它处理的语言很差. 可再生能源基金和时间是根据完成的剪辑计算的。

blocks.en:
Long videos. DVDBench [ 72 ] contains 964 English clips of 84s on average and up to 5 minutes, with whole-second timestamps.
We split each video into 50–60s windows that overlap by 20s, caption them independently, and merge adjacent windows by linking speakers through their shared utterances, without any additional model.
The baselines instead process each clip in a single pass.
Compared with open-weight models, DiaCap achieves the best Acc, WER, IoU, and REF, and trails only D-ORCA in TIME ( Tab. 6 ).
It matches Gemini 3.1 Pro in Acc (87.05 vs . 86.96) but trails both Gemini models in WER and REF, likely because each window is captioned without the rest of the video.
blocks.zh:
长相片. DVD Bench [72] 中包含 964个英语片段平均为84分,最长可达5分钟,并有整秒口卡.
我们把每段视频分成50-60个窗口,重叠20个窗口,独立地给它们作标题,通过共用的演讲语连接相邻的窗口,而没有任何额外的模型。
取而代之的是,基线将每个片段都通过一个通道处理。
相较于开放量级模型,DiaCap实现了最佳Acc,WER,IoU,和REF,并只追踪了Time中的D-ORCA (Tab.
它与Acc(87.05 vs 86.96)中的双子座3.1 Pro相匹配,但追踪了WER和REF中的双子座模型,可能是因为每个窗口都有字幕,没有其他视频.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Long-video evaluation on DVDBench [ 72 ] . Acc, WER, and IoU are the original DVDBench metrics, and TIME uses a 1s tolerance for its whole-second timestamps. Bold and underline mark the best open-weight and proprietary results.
blocks.zh: 表6:DVD Bench上的长视频评价 [72]. Acc,WER,和IoU是最初的DVD Bench 度量衡,而Time则使用1s的容能来进行整秒的印花. 粗放并突出显示最佳的开放量和专有效果。

Direct : each model answers from the video, audio, and question. Caption first : each model generates a caption, from which Qwen3-Omni-Thinking answers the question.
blocks.zh: 表7: AV-Speaker Bench上的视听问答(AV-QA) [57]. 准确的演讲和音频中心问题。 Direct :每个模型从视频,音频,和问题中解答. Caption First :每个模型生成一个标题,从中Quen3-Omni-Thinking回答了问题.

blocks.en:
Audiovisual question answering (AV-QA). We test whether the capabilities of DiaCap transfer to AV-QA ( Tab. 7 ).
AV-SpeakerBench [ 57 ] contains 3,212 four-choice questions ( e.g . , speaker identification and temporal localization of speech) that cannot be answered from a single modality.
Although fine-tuned only for dialogue captioning, DiaCap outperforms its base model, Qwen3-Omni-Thinking, by + + 4.2 Speaker and + + 5.5 Audio in the Direct setting.

blocks.en:
First , DiaCap needs stronger perception in challenging scenes.
For example, small, distant faces provide little lip-motion evidence, which causes DiaCap to split a single utterance across two speakers in Fig. 5 . Second , DiaCap would benefit from stronger reasoning, which could infer the speaker from the dialogue context when the visual evidence is unreliable, as in Fig. 5 . Third , transcription remains a bottleneck for diarization: REF increases by +9.35 for DiaCap given GT transcripts ( Tab. 1 ).
DiaCap-E2E with RL already matches the transcript-conditioned model without an external recognizer, and stronger transcription within the end-to-end model could narrow this gap further.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion

blocks.en:
We presented DiaCap, an audiovisual LLM for comprehensive dialogue captioning that learns utterance timing and audiovisual diarization jointly.
It is trained with dense supervision from 225K synthetically annotated clips and with fine-grained feedback from RL on 2.9K human-corrected clips.
Experimental results showed that DiaCap achieves superior timestamp accuracy and strong audiovisual diarization, and DiaCap-E2E is comparably strong without an external recognizer.

实验结果表明,DiaCap实现了优越的时间戳精确度和强大的视听分化,DiaCap-E2E在没有外部识别器的情况下具有相仿的强度.

These results also support evaluating on redacted videos, as in the main paper.
When burned-in subtitles are visible, a model that sees the video can read the words off the screen instead of recognizing them from the audio.
This changes which recognizer comes out ahead.
Gemini 4 Argon is the only recognizer in Tab. 8 that sees the video, and with it DiaCap now achieves a higher ASR than with the audio-only MAI-Transcribe-2 (82.25 vs . 81.20), the reverse of the redacted results.

Part of the score on the original videos therefore comes from reading subtitles, which favors models that see the video but reveals little about how well a model links speech to speakers.

Audio-centric tasks. In the Direct setting, DiaCap and DiaCap-E2E improve over the base model on five of the six audio-centric tasks (duration, intensity, pitch, rate, and speech recognition), by up to + + 10.6 and + + 12.1 on pitch.
These tasks ask how and when each person speaks, which our captions describe with the timestamps, words, and voice description of every utterance, so this skill carries over to question answering although both models are fine-tuned only to write captions.
DiaCap-E2E, which also learns to transcribe, is the best model on speech recognition (75.6).
The exception is speech counting, where both models fall behind the base model (37.2 and 34.4 vs . 40.3), as its questions ask how many times a phrase is said, often by one person within an interval marked by a visual event, which a model answering directly must tally without writing anything down.
When the models first write out every utterance with its speaker (Caption first), their accuracy rises to 59.7 and 63.9, and DiaCap-E2E is the best in that block.

这些任务询问每个人说话的方式和时间,我们用时间戳、文字和语音描述来描述这些标题,因此,这种技巧继续质疑答案,尽管两个模型都经过了微调,只是为了写标题。
DiaCap-E2E也学习作文,是语音识别的最佳模式(75.6).
例外是语音计数,两个模型都落后于基准模型(37.2和34.4 vs 40.3),因为其疑问是,一个短语讲了多少次,常常是在以视觉事件为标志的间隔内由一个人讲出,模型直接回答必须计数而不写下任何东西.
当模型首次用其扬声器(Caption First)写出每句话时,其精度会上升到59.7和63.9,而DiaCap-E2E是该区块中最好的.

blocks.en:
Speaker-centric tasks. In the Direct setting, the largest gain is on speaker recognition, where DiaCap improves over the base model by + + 6.9 (66.1 vs . 59.2) and is the best model.
These questions ask who says a given line or who speaks right before or after an event, which requires linking each utterance to the visible person who says it, the core of audiovisual diarization that our SFT and RL train.
On speaker counting, DiaCap is − - 1.5 behind the base model (44.3 vs . 45.8).
Each answer gives the number of both speakers and people on screen, and DiaCap errs mostly on the latter by undercounting partly visible people, a visual skill outside our training.
On speaker detection, which asks whether a person speaks before or after an event, DiaCap improves over the base model by + + 6.8 but is − - 0.4 behind D-ORCA (63.5 vs . 63.9).
Like its base model, it tends to answer yes and correctly answers 78 of the 185 questions whose answer is no ( vs . 96 for D-ORCA).
blocks.zh:
以演说为中心的任务. 在"直接设定"中,最大的收益在于对扬声器的识别,DiaCap比起基准模型提高+ 6.9 (66.1 vs 59.2),是最佳模型.
这些问题会问谁说某一行,或者谁在事件之前或之后说话,这需要将每句话与说话的可见者联系起来,即我们SFT和RL列车的视听分化核心.
在扬声器计数中,DiaCap是−-1.5落后于基准模型(44.3对45.8).
每个答案都给出了屏幕上的演讲者和人数,而DiaCap大多在屏幕上错误地低估了部分可见的人,这是我们训练之外的视觉技能.
在扬声器检测中,DiaCap询问某人在事件之前或之后是否说话,DiaCap比基准模型改进了++ 6.8,但是在D-ORCA(63.5对63.9)后面是−-0.4.
与其基础模型一样,它倾向于回答是,正确回答185个回答为否的问题中的78个(对96的D-ORCA).

图7显示了另一起故障案例,其中外屏扬声器与屏幕上唯一一个人被合并.
如图5所示,每个DiaCap栏都显示预测的发言者和文字,没有预测到下面没有栏的地上真话。

blocks.en: Appendix E Additional Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 附录E 额外定性结果

blocks.en:
Figures 8 – 13 show more examples in the layout of Fig. 4 .
Each figure shows one keyframe per ground-truth utterance, labeled with the utterance spoken at that moment.
The timeline compares the ground truth with DiaCap, DiaCap-E2E, Gemini 4 Argon [ 26 ] , and DiaDem [ 8 ] .
Each bar is a predicted utterance placed at its predicted timestamps and colored by the ground-truth speaker that the model’s description depicts (X marks a person who never speaks), and a dark-red outline marks a wrong speaker.
DiaDem predicts no timestamps, so its utterances are drawn as dots under the ground-truth utterances they are matched to.
For each model, correct counts the ground-truth utterances attributed to the right speaker, and TIME is the clip-level TIME score.
DiaCap runs in the Predicted-transcript setting, and the baselines are end-to-end.
The panel below each timeline lists the visual part of each model’s speaker descriptions.
blocks.zh:
图8 – 13在图4的布局中显示了更多的例子.
每个图都显示每个地面真言都有一个关键框架,上面标注的是当时所说的话。
时间表将地面真相与DiaCap,DiaCap-E2E,双子座4 Argon[26],和DiaDem[8]相提并论.
每个栏杆都是在预想的时间戳上放置的预言,由模型描述的地上真话演讲者所描绘的颜色(X标记一个从未发言的人),而暗红色的提纲则标记出一个错误的演讲者.
DiaDem预测没有时间戳,因此其言论如同地上真实的言语相匹配的点.
对每个模型来说,正确计算出归属于正确演讲者的地上真言,而Time是剪接级的Time分数.
DiaCap运行在预设的-transcript设置中,基线为端到端.
每个时间表下面的面板列出每个模型演讲者描述的视觉部分.

blocks.en:
Speakers who are not visible. In conversation scenes, the camera often shows the listener rather than the speaker ( Figs. 8 and 9 ), or the speaker faces away from the camera ( Fig. 10 ).
Baselines tend to assign such lines to whoever is visible, whereas DiaCap and DiaCap-E2E link the voice to the right person across shots.
blocks.zh:
发言者不可见. 在对话场景中,相机经常显示听众而不是扬声器(图8和9),或者扬声器面对相机外(图10.
基线往往将这种行线分配给任何可见者,而DiaCap和DiaCap-E2E则将声音与正确的人通过镜头连接.

blocks.en:
Short turns in fast exchanges. A one-word answer or a brief interjection between longer turns is easily absorbed into a neighboring turn ( Figs. 11 and 12 ).
DiaCap and DiaCap-E2E keep such turns separate with accurate boundaries, whereas baselines with imprecise or no timestamps merge them, which loses the turn and its speaker.
blocks.zh:
短转快交流. 一个单词的答案或一个较长转弯之间的短暂的插口很容易被吸收到相邻转弯(图11和12.
DiaCap和DiaCap-E2E保持这种有准确边界的转弯相分离,而基线没有精确或没有时间戳将它们合并在一起,从而失去转弯和发音。

blocks.en:
Several similar-looking speakers. With three or more speakers in one scene, a description must tell each person apart ( Figs. 13 and 9 ).
DiaDem’s generic descriptions, such as “man in a lab coat”, fit more than one person and lead to swapped or merged speakers, whereas the descriptions of DiaCap remain specific enough to identify each speaker.
blocks.zh:
几位长相相相近的发言者。 在一个场景中有三个或三个以上的演讲者,描述必须分别告诉每个人(图13和图9)。
DiaDem的一般描述,如 " 身穿实验室外衣的人 " ,适合一个以上的人,并导致交换或合并演讲者,而DiaCap的描述仍然足够具体,足以确定每个演讲者的身份。

blocks.en:
Figure 8 : One speaker who goes off-screen. In this typical shot/reverse-shot conversation, a single woman speaks both lines.
During the second line, the camera cuts to the listener and the speaker is off-screen.
DiaCap and DiaCap-E2E attribute both lines to the same speaker.
Gemini 4 Argon gives the second line to the visible listener (short reddish-brown hair).
DiaDem’s description (“woman with shoulder-length brown hair”) is too generic to identify the speaker, so neither of its lines is credited.
blocks.zh:
图8:一名发言者退出审查。 在这种典型的镜头/反镜头对话中,一个单身女性会说两行话.
第二行时相机会切入收听器,扬声器会关闭屏幕.
DiaCap和DiaCap-E2E将两行归属于同名扬声器.
双子座4 Argon将第二行给可见的收听者(短红-褐发).
DiaDem的描述( " 有肩长棕发的女性 " )过于笼统,无法辨别扬声器,因此其行数都不计入。

blocks.en:
Figure 9 : Off-screen speakers in a multi-shot scene. The first and last turns are spoken while the camera shows someone else.
DiaCap and DiaCap-E2E attribute all four turns correctly and describe these speakers as off-screen voices.
Gemini 4 Argon gives the woman’s “Uh, Nal-what?” to the man in the blue lab coat and truncates it.
DiaDem describes both men only as “man in a lab coat”, so the second man’s two turns go to the first man.
blocks.zh:
图9:多镜头场景中的外屏扬声器. 第一次和最后一次是开口,而镜头显示的是其他人。
DiaCap和 DiaCap-E2E 属性都正确转动,并将这些扬声器描述为离屏幕的声音.
双子座4 Argon将女子的"Uh, Nal-What?"交给了穿蓝色实验室外衣的男子并切除.
DiaDem只将两人描述为"穿着实验室外衣的人",

blocks.en:
Figure 10 : A speaker seen only from behind. The last line is spoken by the man with his back to the camera.
DiaCap and DiaCap-E2E attribute it to him.
Gemini 4 Argon gives it to the man in the gray suit and DiaDem to the man with the mustache, the two people whose faces are visible.
blocks.zh:
图10:只从后面看到的一名发言者。 最后一句由背着相机的人说出.
Diacap和Diacap-E2E都怪他
双子座4 Argon把它交给了穿灰色西装的人,而DiaDem则交给了有胡子的人,两人的相貌明显.

blocks.en:
Figure 11 : A one-word turn right before another speaker (Mandarin). The young man answers with a single syllable lasting 0.3s (first frame), and the man in the gray suit continues immediately (second frame).
DiaCap and DiaCap-E2E keep the short turn as a separate line with the correct speaker.
Gemini 4 Argon and DiaDem merge it into the next speaker’s line, so turn A is lost.
Gemini’s timestamps also miss every boundary (TIME 0), and DiaDem predicts none.
This example shows that accurate timestamps and diarization are tightly coupled, as a model without precise turn boundaries tends to absorb a short turn into a longer neighboring one.
blocks.zh:
图11:一个单词在另一个发言者(普通话)之前右转。 年轻人以单音节持续0.3分(第一帧)来回答,而穿灰色西装的男子则立即继续(第二帧).
DiaCap和DiaCap-E2E保持短转弯,作为与正确扬声器的单独一行.
双子座4Argon和DiaDem将其合并到下一位演讲者的一行,因此转会A丢失.
双子座时间戳也错过了每一个边界(TIME 0), DiaDem预测没有。
这个例子表明,准确的时间戳和分化是紧密相接的,因为没有精确转弯边界的模型往往会吸收短暂的转弯而成为相邻更长的转弯.

blocks.en:
Figure 12 : A short interjection from a third speaker. DiaCap and DiaCap-E2E attribute all four turns correctly and place every boundary within the collar.
Gemini 4 Argon merges the woman’s two turns into one line, so when scoring Gemini, we merge consecutive ground-truth utterances from the same speaker, which leaves three ground-truth turns.
Gemini’s timestamps miss most boundaries (TIME 33).
DiaDem describes the speaker of the final interjection only as “man’s voice”, which depicts none of the people in the scene.
blocks.zh:
图12:第三发言者的简短插口。 DiaCap和DiaCap-E2E属性所有四个转弯都正确,并将每个边界都置于项圈内.
双子座4 Argon将女双合并成一行,因此当双子座得分时,我们合并了同一位演讲者连续发表的地上真话,这留下了三个地上真话转折.
双子座时间戳错过了大部分边界(TIME 33).
DiaDem只把最后的插话者形容为 " 人的声音 " ,

blocks.en:
Figure 13 : Four speakers in one room. DiaCap, DiaCap-E2E, and Gemini 4 Argon attribute all five turns correctly.
DiaDem gets three of the five turns wrong.
It gives “Are you serious?” (C) and “Me too.” (D) to the young woman, and gives her own “I’m okay with that.” to a young man.
Gemini’s timestamps drift by about 0.7s on the last three turns (TIME 40), whereas both DiaCap variants place every boundary within the collar (TIME 100).
blocks.zh:
图13:一个会议室有四名发言者。 DiaCap, DiaCap-E2E,和双子座4Argon属性所有五个转正.
迪亚·德姆在5个转错3个.
它给出了“你是认真的吗?” (C)和“我也一样”。 (D) 给这位年轻女性,
双子座的时间戳在后三个转弯(TIME 40)上漂移了大约0.7分左右,而DiaCap两个变体将每个分界线都置于领内(TIME 100).
